general.descriptionTextModule: Connect your storefront to the WisWes AI shopping assistant

status.title: WisWes Chat Widget
status.subtitle: AI shopping assistant for your storefront
status.notConnectedBody: Click below to create your WisWes tenant and install the chat widget on your storefront. No manual configuration needed.
status.connectedBody: The widget is live on your storefront. Manage prompts, intents, and analytics from your WisWes dashboard.
status.installSuccess: Connected — your widget will appear on the storefront within a minute.
status.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect from WisWes? The widget will stop appearing on your storefront. Your tenant on app.wiswes.com is preserved so you can reconnect later.
